newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Soccer-Cascarino takes his chance and scores two.
newsitem.headline: Soccer-Cascarino takes his chance and scores two.

text.p: Striker Tony Cascarino made the most of his surprise call-up to score twice as Ireland beat Macedonia 3-0 in a World Cup European group eight qualifier at Lansdowne Road on Wednesday.

"I am really pleased, I didn't think I would be playing tonight. I only got in because Niall Quinn is injured but then I thought John Aldridge might start. So I am just delighted to got my chance and to score two is great," Cascarino said.
"I think the quick goal I scored early in the second-half killed them off really. Their lads seemed to just drop their heads after that one," he added.
Cascarino scored his first in the 47th minute when he latched on to a poor headed back-pass by defender Zoran Jovanovski and fired into the right corner from 10 metres to put the home side 2-0 ahead.
The Olympique Marseille striker notched his second goal of the match in the 70th minute when he headed home a cross from Jeff Kenna.

Ireland, who have won their opening two matches with a goal tally of 8-0, took the lead in the eighth minute when midfielder Jason McAteer fired an unstoppable shot into the roof of the Macedonia net from the edge of the penalty area after he had been put through by Alan McLoughlin.
Macedonia, who played six players in midfield, largely relied on the break for creating goal-scoring chances.

A swift break along the left flank almost resulted in a goal for the visitors in the 42nd minute when striker Gorgi Hristov had a 25-yard shot brilliantly tipped around the left post by Ireland goalkeeper Alan Kelly.
Ireland only made the game safe when Cascarino scored the first of his brace two minutes after the break. Lineups:

Ireland: 1-Alan Kelly; 3-Denis Irwin, 5-Gary Breen, 6-Steve Staunton; 2-Jeff Kenna, 10-Jason McAteer, 8-Alan McLoughlin (18- Liam O'Brien, 89th), 7-Andy Townsend, 4-Ian Harte (15-Alan Moore, 86th); 9-Keith O'Neill (14-John Aldridge, 82nd), 11-Tony Cascarino.

Macedonia: 1-Danco Celeski; 4-Goce Sedloski, 5-Igor Sasa Nikolovski, 6-Zoran Jovanovski; 2-Riste Milosavov, 7-Vlatko Gosev, 10-Sasa Cicic, 11-Saso Milosevski (13-Srdjan Zaharievski, 61st), 5-Igor Sasa Nikolovski, 3-Husni Beganovic (15-Vanco Micevski, 74th); 9-Gorgi Hristov.
